# RACE Innovations

> RACE Innovations is an automotive market intelligence and consulting firm headquartered in Chennai, India. We publish automotive market reports, vehicle sales forecast reports, EV market intelligence, OEM benchmarking studies and country-wise automotive industry research used by OEMs, suppliers, investors and strategy teams globally.

RACE Innovations covers the global automotive industry across passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, two-wheelers, three-wheelers, tractors and construction equipment. Our research includes country-wise automotive market reports for India, USA, China, UK, Australia, Brazil, Germany, Japan, Indonesia, Thailand, South Africa, Vietnam, Malaysia, Mexico, and more. We also operate a dedicated Location Based Intelligence (LBI) practice for ODC (Over-Dimensional Cargo) logistics route surveys.

## Primary entry points

- [Homepage](https://raceinnovations.in/): RACE Innovations corporate overview, services and contact.
- [Automotive Market Reports](https://raceinnovations.in/market-report): Country-wise and segment-wise automotive market reports, vehicle sales forecasts, EV intelligence, OEM benchmarking.
- [LBI Reports](https://raceinnovations.in/lbi-reports): Location Based Intelligence reports for ODC route feasibility and logistics planning.
- [All Reports](https://raceinnovations.in/reports): Full library of published RACE Innovations reports.
- [Web Blog](https://raceinnovations.in/web-blog): Automotive industry articles, trends and analysis.

## Services

- [Technic](https://raceinnovations.in/technic): Engineering design, product development and validation services.
- [Intellect](https://raceinnovations.in/intellect): Market research, competitive intelligence and strategy advisory.
- [LBI Route Survey](https://raceinnovations.in/intellect/lbi): Over-Dimensional Cargo route feasibility surveys.
- [ODC Logistics](https://raceinnovations.in/logistics): End-to-end ODC logistics planning and execution support.
- [Connect](https://raceinnovations.in/connect): RACE Connect — India market-entry program for global automotive companies.
- [Accounting & Legal](https://raceinnovations.in/accounting-and-legal): Cross-border tax, advisory and legal services.
- [IT Services](https://raceinnovations.in/it): Custom software, CRM, digital and mining-domain IT solutions.
- [Corporate Profile](https://raceinnovations.in/corporate-profile): Full company profile flipbook.

## Topics we cover authoritatively

- Automotive market reports and forecasts (global, country-wise, segment-wise)
- Vehicle sales data: India, USA, China, UK, Australia, Brazil, Germany, Japan, Indonesia, Thailand
- EV market intelligence: China EV market, India EV, global EV adoption forecast
- OEM benchmarking and competitive analysis
- Commercial vehicle (truck, bus, LCV) market reports
- Passenger vehicle (SUV, sedan, hatchback) market reports
- Two-wheeler, three-wheeler, tractor, construction equipment market reports
- Automotive components, supply chain and logistics
- ODC (Over-Dimensional Cargo) route survey and Location Based Intelligence (LBI)
- Automotive industry trends, growth, future outlook
- India-specific: car sales data, monthly sales of cars, automobile sales data India
- China-specific: china auto market, china automotive, china electric car, EV market in China
- USA-specific: US auto industry, automotive industry United States, American car manufacturing
- UK-specific: UK automakers, UK car dealers, used cars in England
- Australia-specific: Australia vehicle sales, cars for sale Australia
